member.summary: Gets the date from the last internal calibration.

member.name: P:OmicronLab.VectorNetworkAnalysis.AutomationInterface.Interfaces.Calibration.InternalCalibration.DateExecuted
member.summary: Gets the date from the last internal calibration in UTC.
member.remarks: NOT supported in LabWindows CVI and Delphi. Alternatively can be used.

member.name: M:OmicronLab.VectorNetworkAnalysis.AutomationInterface.Interfaces.Calibration.InternalCalibration.DateExecutedAsString(System.String)
member.summary: Converts the value of the execution date in UTC to its equivalent string representation using the specified format and the formatting conventions of the current culture.
member.remarks: The format parameter should contain either a single format specifier character (see Standard Date and Time Format String (e.g. 'u' describing the Universal sortable date/time pattern)) or a custom format pattern (see Custom Date and Time Format Strings (e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) that defines the format of the returned string. If format is null or an empty string, the general format specifier, 'G', is used.

member.name: P:OmicronLab.VectorNetworkAnalysis.AutomationInterface.Interfaces.Calibration.InternalCalibration.LocalDateExecuted
member.summary: Gets the date from the last internal calibration in local time.
member.remarks: NOT supported in LabWindows CVI and Delphi. Alternatively can be used.

member.name: M:OmicronLab.VectorNetworkAnalysis.AutomationInterface.Interfaces.Calibration.InternalCalibration.LocalDateExecutedAsString(System.String)
member.summary: Converts the value of the execution date in local time to its equivalent string representation using the specified format and the formatting conventions of the current culture.
member.remarks: The format parameter should contain either a single format specifier character (see Standard Date and Time Format String (e.g. 'u' describing the Universal sortable date/time pattern)) or a custom format pattern (see Custom Date and Time Format Strings (e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) that defines the format of the returned string. If format is null or an empty string, the general format specifier, 'G', is used.
